items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: She played the harpsichord and I was teaching Sylvia jazz, you know?

ctx.x: This is sort of an off beat thing that I was looking through. We have some clippings at the Institute, you know, in our files and in one of them I saw an item which may have been just a press agent's item, but there might be something to it. You were teaching Sylvia Marlowe to play...
Yeah. She played the harpsichord and I was teaching Sylvia jazz, you know? And blues. She knew the fundamentals... Teaching...I'm not sure whether it's teaching or instructing.

To tell a person or to show a person, or to demonstrate, or to illustrate...now, I'm wondering what did I really do? Did I teach her...because she learned how to play a lot of things, you know what I mean...
